sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Madhav Khurana, Sr. Advocate
 with Mr. Amit, Ms. Kamakshi Gup
 and Mr. Yogesh Panwar, Advocate
 versus
 State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr.

Through: Mr
 St
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
ORDER % 02.02.2026 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. Petitioner seeks quashing of charge-sheet arising out of FIR No.520/2022 dated 29.11.2022,
registered at P.S. Anand Vihar, for commission of offences under Sections 498A/406/323/377 IPC.

2. When asked, learned Senior Counsel for petitioner submitted that petitioner is husband of complainant, and for the reason best known to prosecution, he has even been charge-sheeted for commission of offence under Section 377 IPC.

3. Let a comprehensive report be filed by respondent No.1/State by next date of hearing with advance copy to opposite side.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 03/02/2026 at 20:40:10 4.

5. Issue notice to victim/respondent No.2 through all permissible modes.
6.
Petitioner would be at liberty to move application seeking his exemption from personal appearance before the learned Trial Court.
However it will be entirely upto the learned Trial Court to consider the same and to dispose of the same in accordance with law, after giving due opportunity of hearing to both the sides.
